prepared.title: Project status changes are not reflected in the progress table
prepared.summary: The user updates a project's status, but the overview table continues to show the previous progress value.
stepsToReproduce: Return to the recent projects table
prepared.expectedBehaviour: The status and progress values should refresh immediately after the change is saved.
prepared.actualBehaviour: The table continues to display stale project values until the page is reloaded.
prepared.developerNotes: Review client-side cache invalidation and the project-list refresh triggered after a successful update.
